quote:
A heart that yearns for quick peace must learn that the river still runs its own course, even when its currents change with the wind.

Oil prices glide like a cloud, for they rise not when the sky brightens, but when the hopeful heart mistakes fog for freedom.

When a child leaves the shadows of forbidden learning, she carries the illumination of a single word that no wall can contain.

Even a single fallen soldier is the echo of countless unseen drums striking in a forgotten battlefield.

The roar of riot police in the streets of dissent is louder than the quiet murmur of future generations.

A train pierced by a sudden blast proves that even great iron can surprise, for the strongest rails quake at the loudest silence.

When toxic water drains into an open field, the healer must trek through invisible waves, for the greatest danger often wears a silent face.
